\"published\")\n\n\ndef test_home_lists_published_posts_but_not_drafts(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live Post\", \"live-post\", \"published\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Hidden Draft\", \"hidden-draft\", \"draft\")\n\n    for path in (\"/\", \"/index.html\"):\n        html = client.get(path).text\n        assert 'href=\"posts/live-post.html\"' in html\n        assert \"Hidden Draft\" not in html\n\n\ndef test_published_post_is_served_and_a_draft_is_404(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live Post\", \"live-post\", \"published\")\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Hidden Draft\", _seed(\"page\", \"Secret\", \"secret\", \"draft\")\n\n    response = client.get(\"/about.html\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<h1>About</h1>\" in response.text\n    assert client.get(\"/secret.html\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_nav_link_from_a_post_page_resolves_on_the_dev_server(client):\n    _seed(\"post\", \"Live Post\", \"live-post\", \"published\")\n    _seed(\"page\", \"About\", \"about\", \"published\")\n\n    html = client.get(\"/posts/live-post.html\").text\n    assert 'href=\"../about.html\"' in html  # /posts/../about.html -> /about.html\n That is what spend() does, and it is your exercise.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport csv\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nLEDGER = Path(\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\")\n\n\ndef spend(series: list[float | None]) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Total rise across a meter that can reset to a lower value.\n\n    Sum every increase between consecutive readings; ignore blanks (None) and\n    any drop, which means the window reset.\n\n    >>> spend([10.0, 12.0, 15.0])\n    5.0\n    >>> spend([80.0, 5.0, 9.0])\n    4.0\n    >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])\n    3.0\n    \"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\"MP2 Exercise B: implement me with /tdd\")\n\ndef read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:\n        return list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\n\ndef to_float(text: str | None) -> float | None:\n    try:\n        return float(text) if text not in (None, \"\") else None\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef by_phase(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:\n    phases: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(\n        lambda: {\"turns\": 0, \"five\": [], \"weekly\": [], \"models\": set(), \"providers\": set()}\n    )\n    for row in rows:\n        phase = phases[row.get(\"phase\") or \"unlabelled\"]\n        phase[\"turns\"] += 1\n        phase[\"five\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"five_h_pct\")))\n        phase[\"weekly\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"weekly_pct\")))\n        if row.get(\"model\"):\n            phase[\"models\"].add(row[\"model\"])\n        if row.get(\"provider\"):\n            phase[\"providers\"].add(row[\"provider\"])\n    return phases\n\n\ndef ticket_phases(phases: dict[str, dict]) -> list[str]:\n    return sorted(p for p in phases if p.upper().startswith(\"T\") and p[1:].isdigit())\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ledger\", type=Path, default=LEDGER)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--remaining\", type=int, default=0, help=\"tickets not yet built\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if not args.ledger.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"No ledger at {args.ledger}. Is the Stop hook registered?\")\n    rows = read_rows(args.ledger)\n    if not rows:\n        raise SystemExit(\"Ledger is empty.\")\n    phases = by_phase(rows)\n\n    print(f\"{'phase':<14}{'turns':>6}{'5h spent':>10}{'weekly':>9}  models / provider\")\n    for name, data in sorted(phases.items()):\n        mix = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"models\"])) or \"?\"\n        prov = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"providers\"] - {\"anthropic\"}))\n        print(f\"{name:<14}{data['turns']:>6}{spend(data['five']):>9.1f}%\"\n              f\"{spend(data['weekly']):>8.1f}%  {mix}{(' @' + prov) if prov else ''}\")\n\n    tickets = ticket_phases(phases)\n    if tickets:\n        per = sum(spend(phases[t][\"weekly\"]) for t in tickets) / len(tickets)\n        print(f\"\\nTickets done: {len(tickets)} · average weekly cost per ticket: {per:.1f}%\")\n        last = next((to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) for r in reversed(rows)\n                     if to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) is not None), None)\n        if last is not None and args.remaining:\n            need, headroom = per * args.remaining, 100 - last\n            verdict = \"FITS\" if need <= headroom * 0.8 else \"TIGHT\" if need <= headroom else \"OVER BUDGET\"\n            print(f\"Forecast: {args.remaining} tickets need ~{need:.0f}% of the weekly cap; \"\n                  f\"{headroom:.0f}% remains → {verdict}\")\n            if verdict != \"FITS\":\n                print(\"Fix in this order: 1) lower effort  2) switch to Sonnet/Haiku  \"\n                      \"3) /clear more often  4) split fat tickets  5) Plan B backend (declare it)\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo ticket phases yet. Write the ticket id into .claude/state/phase \"\n              \"at the start of each /implement session.\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","numLines":111,"startLine":1,"totalLines":111}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3ede95cf-a08e-481d-81b9-708a51daf3cd","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

Summing\nonly the increases between consecutive rows measures what you actually spent\nand ignores the resets. That is what spend() does, and it is your exercise.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport csv\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nLEDGER = Path(\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\")\n\n\ndef spend(series: list[float | None]) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Total rise across a meter that can reset to a lower value.\n\n    Sum every increase between consecutive readings; ignore blanks (None) and\n    any drop, which means the window reset.\n\n    >>> spend([10.0, 12.0, 15.0])\n    5.0\n    >>> spend([80.0, 5.0, 9.0])\n    4.0\n    >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])\n    3.0\n    \"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\"MP2 Exercise B: implement me with /tdd\")\n\ndef read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:\n        return list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\n\ndef to_float(text: str | None) -> float | None:\n    try:\n        return float(text) if text not in (None, \"\") else None\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef by_phase(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:\n    phases: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(\n        lambda: {\"turns\": 0, \"five\": [], \"weekly\": [], \"models\": set(), \"providers\": set()}\n    )\n    for row in rows:\n        phase = phases[row.get(\"phase\") or \"unlabelled\"]\n        phase[\"turns\"] += 1\n        phase[\"five\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"five_h_pct\")))\n        phase[\"weekly\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"weekly_pct\")))\n        if row.get(\"model\"):\n            phase[\"models\"].add(row[\"model\"])\n        if row.get(\"provider\"):\n            phase[\"providers\"].add(row[\"provider\"])\n    return phases\n\n\ndef ticket_phases(phases: dict[str, dict]) -> list[str]:\n    return sorted(p for p in phases if p.upper().startswith(\"T\") and p[1:].isdigit())\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ledger\", type=Path, default=LEDGER)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--remaining\", type=int, default=0, help=\"tickets not yet built\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if not args.ledger.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"No ledger at {args.ledger}. Is the Stop hook registered?\")\n    rows = read_rows(args.ledger)\n    if not rows:\n        raise SystemExit(\"Ledger is empty.\")\n    phases = by_phase(rows)\n\n    print(f\"{'phase':<14}{'turns':>6}{'5h spent':>10}{'weekly':>9}  models / provider\")\n    for name, data in sorted(phases.items()):\n        mix = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"models\"])) or \"?\"\n        prov = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"providers\"] - {\"anthropic\"}))\n        print(f\"{name:<14}{data['turns']:>6}{spend(data['five']):>9.1f}%\"\n              f\"{spend(data['weekly']):>8.1f}%  {mix}{(' @' + prov) if prov else ''}\")\n\n    tickets = ticket_phases(phases)\n    if tickets:\n        per = sum(spend(phases[t][\"weekly\"]) for t in tickets) / len(tickets)\n        print(f\"\\nTickets done: {len(tickets)} · average weekly cost per ticket: {per:.1f}%\")\n        last = next((to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) for r in reversed(rows)\n                     if to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) is not None), None)\n        if last is not None and args.remaining:\n            need, headroom = per * args.remaining, 100 - last\n            verdict = \"FITS\" if need <= headroom * 0.8 else \"TIGHT\" if need <= headroom else \"OVER BUDGET\"\n            print(f\"Forecast: {args.remaining} tickets need ~{need:.0f}% of the weekly cap; \"\n                  f\"{headroom:.0f}% remains → {verdict}\")\n            if verdict != \"FITS\":\n                print(\"Fix in this order: 1) lower effort  2) switch to Sonnet/Haiku  \"\n                      \"3) /clear more often  4) split fat tickets  5) Plan B backend (declare it)\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo ticket phases yet. Write the ticket id into .claude/state/phase \"\n              \"at the start of each /implement session.\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":33,"oldLines":7,"newStart":33,"newLines":14,"lines":["     >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])","     3.0","     \"\"\"","-    raise NotImplementedError(\"MP2 Exercise B: implement me with /tdd\")","+    total, previous = 0.0, None","+    for reading in series:","+        if reading is None:","+            continue","+        if previous is not None and reading > previous:","+            total += reading - previous","+        previous = reading","+    return total"," "," def read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:","     with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1ea2c4c1-f6f0-43bc-bb92-98e064d70199","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

Full suite: 163 passed.\n  \n  (a) Documented-standard violations: none.\n  - templates/admin/base.html, `/style.css` and `/admin`: these don't break CLAUDE.md \"Published HTML uses relative paths only\". Admin templates are never rendered by render_site(). The same file already had root-absolute `href=\"/admin\"` links before this diff. The default in templates/base.html is still relative (`css_path | default('style.css')`). Published output still uses relative paths throughout: publish.py derives css_path/home_path/nav from `prefix`, and test_public_site checks `../about.html`.\n  - \"Only published content reaches site/\": respected. public.py serves only rows from get_published_by_slug (`status = ?` with STATUS_PUBLISHED). The home feed uses list_published, and drafts return 404 (tests cover this).\n  - \"Ask before adding a dependency\": respected. The .env reader is stdlib only, and the settings docstring says why.\n  - CSRF, argon2 and sanitisation are untouched. The preview fix only changes how the client handles a failed fetch.\n  \n  (b) Smells (judgement calls):\n  - Duplicated Code, app/routes/auth.py: `_user_by_email(email.strip().lower())` repeats the normalisation in app/users.py `validate_email` (`raw.strip().lower()`). That makes the \"stored lowercased\" rule a two-place edit. A `users.normalize_email()` would match the existing `content.normalize_slug` convention.\n  - Speculative Generality / Shotgun Surgery, app/content.py `RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"page\": {\"index\"}}` against content_crud: the lookup is keyed by kind and can hold more slugs, but the error text is hard-wired to one case: `'\"{normalized_slug}\" is reserved for the site\\'s home page'`. Adding a second reserved slug would give it a wrong message. Either make it a flat constant or keep the reason next to each slug.\n  - Duplicated Code, tests: tests/test_public_site.py `_seed` is a third copy, after test_export.py and test_dashboard.py. A shared conftest helper would fix this.\n  - Minor, app/publish.py: `home_html()` and `render_site()` each call `list_published(\"post\")`, so the export queries posts twice. Also, `environment()` is now rebuilt for every rendered page, where before one Environment served the whole export. Behaviour is the same, it's just wasteful.\n  \n  (c) Correctness:\n  - Demonstrated: app/settings.py `load_dotenv` reads with `encoding=\"utf-8\"`, not `\"utf-8-sig\"`. A `.env` saved with a BOM keeps the BOM in its first key. I wrote such a file and the first key came out as `'﻿ZZ_FIRST'`. On a real file that would silently drop CMS_SECRET_KEY, so the app falls back to `dev-only-not-for-production` with no warning. This is a realistic risk here: PowerShell 5.1 `Out-File` and `>` write a UTF-8 BOM by default (per the environment notes). The fix is one word: `encoding=\"utf-8-sig\"`.\n  - Also demonstrated (less important): inline comments are kept as part of the value. `KEY=abc # note` gives `'abc # note'`, and `KEY=\"a\" # c` keeps its quotes. An `export KEY=` line becomes a key named `EXPORT KEY`. .env.example uses none of these forms, so either document it or ignore it.\n  - Route ordering: no bug. Starlette's `{slug}` matches `[^/]+` and the `.html` suffix is regex-escaped, so `/{slug}.html` can't match `/posts/x.html` or `/style.css`. No admin or auth route ends in `.html`, and public.router is included last.\n  - tests/test_settings.py environ isolation: no leak. `monkeypatch.setattr(os, \"environ\", copy)` is undone after each test, and `load_dotenv` looks up `os.environ` when it's called, so it writes to the copy.\n  - Caveat: `load_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")` runs when settings is imported, so the test process now picks up the developer's real .env (e.g. CMS_SITE_TITLE). Tests pass because they compare against `settings.SITE_TITLE`, not a literal string. A future test that hard-codes a value from .env would pass or fail depending on whose machine runs it.\n</agent-message>"}

A shared conftest helper would fix this.\n  - Minor, app/publish.py: `home_html()` and `render_site()` each call `list_published(\"post\")`, so the export queries posts twice. Also, `environment()` is now rebuilt for every rendered page, where before one Environment served the whole export. Behaviour is the same, it's just wasteful.\n  \n  (c) Correctness:\n  - Demonstrated: app/settings.py `load_dotenv` reads with `encoding=\"utf-8\"`, not `\"utf-8-sig\"`. On a real file that would silently drop CMS_SECRET_KEY, so the app falls back to `dev-only-not-for-production` with no warning. This is a realistic risk here: PowerShell 5.1 `Out-File` and `>` write a UTF-8 BOM by default (per the environment notes). The fix is one word: `encoding=\"utf-8-sig\"`.\n  - Also demonstrated (less important): inline comments are kept as part of the value. `KEY=abc # note` gives `'abc # note'`, and `KEY=\"a\" # c` keeps its quotes. An `export KEY=` line becomes a key named `EXPORT KEY`. .env.example uses none of these forms, so either document it or ignore it.\n  - Route ordering: no bug. Starlette's `{slug}` matches `[^/]+` and the `.html` suffix is regex-escaped, so `/{slug}.html` can't match `/posts/x.html` or `/style.css`. No admin or auth route ends in `.html`, and public.router is included last.\n  - tests/test_settings.py environ isolation: no leak. `monkeypatch.setattr(os, \"environ\", copy)` is undone after each test, and `load_dotenv` looks up `os.environ` when it's called, so it writes to the copy.\n  - Caveat: `load_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")` runs when settings is imported, so the test process now picks up the developer's real .env (e.g. CMS_SITE_TITLE). Tests pass because they compare against `settings.SITE_TITLE`, not a literal string. No ORM\n(see spec Implementation Decisions).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom app.security import hash_password\n\nROLES = {\"admin\", \"editor\"}\n\nEMAIL_RE = re.compile(r\"^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$\")\n\n\ndef validate_email(raw: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Normalize `raw` and return it if it looks like an email, else None.\"\"\"\n    normalized = raw.strip().lower()\n    return normalized if EMAIL_RE.match(normalized) else None\n\n\ndef list_users() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC\").fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user(user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef create_user(email: str, password: str, role: str) -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)\",\n            (email, hash_password(password), role),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return cur.lastrowid\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef set_role(user_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ?\", (role, user_id))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef deactivate_user(user_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = 0 WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":13,"oldLines":9,"newStart":13,"newLines":14,"lines":[" EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r\"^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$\")"," "," ","+def normalize_email(raw: str) -> str:","+    \"\"\"Accounts are stored in this form, so every lookup must use it too.\"\"\"","+    return raw.strip().lower()","+","+"," def validate_email(raw: str) -> str | None:","     \"\"\"Normalize `raw` and return it if it looks like an email, else None.\"\"\"","-    normalized = raw.strip().lower()","+    normalized = normalize_email(raw)","     return normalized if EMAIL_RE.match(normalized) else None"," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"510cac08-1258-437a-9dcc-21938683a71e","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

{"parentUuid":"e95f9562-1de4-4878-ac89-60137b8a8c7a","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"ec293639-c3cc-497a-8e97-486cc650b15c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0183isHSbwep2fkZAMzCPnv3","type":"tool_result","content":"The file C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\auth.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"09592d24-e28a-457d-bbf8-19c3d1dc3321","timestamp":"2026-10-06T15:08:11.731Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\auth.py","oldString":"    row = _user_by_email(email.strip().lower())  # accounts are stored lowercased","newString":"    row = _user_by_email(users_module.normalize_email(email))","originalFile":"\"\"\"Login, logout, and the current-user lookup every protected route reuses.\n\nThe login form carries a CSRF token like every other state-changing form —\n`security.read_or_mint_csrf` works for anonymous requests too, keyed only on\nthe request's cookies, not on who's logged in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom app import security, settings\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef _render_login(request: Request, error: str | None, status_code: int = 200):\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"error\": error, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The logged-in user's row, or None. Reusable as a FastAPI dependency.\"\"\"\n    uid = security.read_session(request.cookies.get(security.SESSION_COOKIE))\n    if uid is None:\n        return None\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND active = 1\", (uid,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _user_by_email(email: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    if current_user(request) is not None:\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    return _render_login(request, error=None)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403)\n\n    row = _user_by_email(email.strip().lower())  # accounts are stored lowercased\n    if row is None or not security.verify_password(password, row[\"password_hash\"]):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Incorrect email or password.\", status_code=401)\n    if not row[\"active\"]:\n        return _render_login(\n            request,\n            error=\"This account has been deactivated. Contact an Admin if you need access restored.\",\n            status_code=403,\n        )\n\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    response.set_cookie(\n        security.SESSION_COOKIE, security.sign_session(row[\"id\"]),\n        httponly=True, samesite=\"lax\", max_age=security.SESSION_MAX_AGE,\n    )\n    return response\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(...)):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please log in again.\", status_code=403)\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    response.delete_cookie(security.SESSION_COOKIE)\n    return response\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":68,"oldLines":7,"newStart":68,"newLines":7,"lines":["     if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):","         return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403)"," ","-    row = _user_by_email(email.strip().lower())  # accounts are stored lowercased","+    row = _user_by_email(users_module.normalize_email(email))","     if row is None or not security.verify_password(password, row[\"password_hash\"]):","         return _render_login(request, error=\"Incorrect email or password.\", status_code=401)","     if not row[\"active\"]:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e95f9562-1de4-4878-ac89-60137b8a8c7a","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

Reusable as a FastAPI dependency.\"\"\"\n    uid = security.read_session(request.cookies.get(security.SESSION_COOKIE))\n    if uid is None:\n        return None\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND active = 1\", (uid,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _user_by_email(email: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    if current_user(request) is not None:\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    return _render_login(request, error=None)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403)\n\n    row = _user_by_email(users_module.normalize_email(email))\n    if row is None or not security.verify_password(password, row[\"password_hash\"]):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Incorrect email or password.\", status_code=401)\n    if not row[\"active\"]:\n        return _render_login(\n            request,\n            error=\"This account has been deactivated. Contact an Admin if you need access restored.\",\n            status_code=403,\n        )\n\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    response.set_cookie(\n        security.SESSION_COOKIE, security.sign_session(row[\"id\"]),\n        httponly=True, samesite=\"lax\", max_age=security.SESSION_MAX_AGE,\n    )\n    return response\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(...)):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please log in again.\", status_code=403)\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    response.delete_cookie(security.SESSION_COOKIE)\n    return response\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":14,"oldLines":6,"newStart":14,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," from app import db as db_module"," from app import security, settings","+from app import users as users_module"," "," templates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))"," router = APIRouter()"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"200ce4dd-9eee-44fc-82e0-8865a999c5ee","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

Maps kind -> {slug: what it would clobber}.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"page\": {\"index\": \"the site's home page\"}}\n\n\ndef reserved_slug_reason(kind: str, slug: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"What `slug` is reserved for within `kind`, or None if it's free.\"\"\"\n    return RESERVED_SLUGS.get(kind, {}).get(slug)","originalFile":"\"\"\"Content (Posts and Pages) data access. No ORM (see spec Implementation\nDecisions). Posts and Pages share this one table and these functions,\ndistinguished only by `kind` ('post' | 'page') — see CONTEXT.md.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nSLUG_RE = re.compile(r\"^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$\")\n\nSTATUS_DRAFT = \"draft\"\nSTATUS_PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n# A Page is exported to site/<slug>.html, so these slugs would overwrite a\n# file the export itself writes (site/index.html is the home page).\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"page\": {\"index\"}}\n\n\ndef is_reserved_slug(kind: str, slug: str) -> bool:\n    return slug in RESERVED_SLUGS.get(kind, set())\n\n\ndef normalize_slug(raw: str) -> str:\n    return raw.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef validate_slug(raw: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Normalize `raw` and return it if it's a valid slug, else None.\"\"\"\n    normalized = normalize_slug(raw)\n    return normalized if SLUG_RE.match(normalized) else None\n\n\ndef list_content(kind: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT content.*, users.email AS author_email FROM content \"\n            \"JOIN users ON users.id = content.author_id \"\n            \"WHERE content.kind = ? ORDER BY content.created_at DESC\",\n            (kind,),\n        ).fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_published(kind: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM content WHERE kind = ? AND status = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC\",\n            (kind, STATUS_PUBLISHED),\n        ).fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef count_by_status() -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Combined draft/published counts across both kinds (Posts and Pages\n    together) — the dashboard shows one total, not split by type.\"\"\"\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM content GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    counts = {STATUS_DRAFT: 0, STATUS_PUBLISHED: 0}\n    for row in rows:\n        counts[row[\"status\"]] = row[\"n\"]\n    return counts\n\n\ndef list_filtered(*, status: str | None = None, kind: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"All content (Posts and Pages together), optionally narrowed by\n    status and/or kind. AND slug = ? AND status = ?\",\n            (kind, slug, STATUS_PUBLISHED),\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_content(content_id: int, kind: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM content WHERE id = ? AND kind = ?\", (content_id, kind)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef create_content(kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO content (kind, title, slug, body_md, author_id) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (kind, title, slug, body_md, author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return cur.lastrowid\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_content(content_id: int, kind: str, title: str, slug: str, body_md: str) -> None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE content SET title = ?, slug = ?, body_md = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ? Everything worked. The seed loaded from .env alone. \"/\" lists Welcome and leaves out the draft. /posts/welcome.html and /about.html return 200, the draft URL returns 404, and every link on the home page resolves. Login as admin@example.test works with the .env.example password. All admin pages link href=\"/style.css\". The export has no root-absolute links. No public route can serve a draft: get_published_by_slug filters on status=\"published\", and nav_items, list_published and home_html only read published rows.\n  \n  (a) ACs missing or partial\n  - \"A Page cannot be saved with a slug reserved by the export (index)\": the check is in the shared _save, so it runs on edit as well as create, and on \"Index\" after it is lowercased. Two gaps:\n    - Only create is tested; the edit route has no test.\n    - A Page already in the database with slug \"index\" (made before T10) can still be published, and render_site would then overwrite index.html. Nothing guards the export itself. It meets the AC's wording, but the reason for the ticket (\"overwrites the home page in the export\") isn't fully closed.\n  - \"The live preview shows a clear 'session expired' message\": the code catches both the redirect and !ok. The text says \"your session may have expired\", and a plain network error shows the same message. That's acceptable. As expected, nothing tests it.\n  - AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4, AC7 and AC8 are met and covered by running tests. AC8 is test_statusline_then_stop_hook, which passed here on Windows.\n  \n  (b) Scope creep\n  - seed.py now seeds a published \"Welcome\" post and adds a draft post. It also rewrites the welcome text. This is arguably needed so AC7's home page shows something, but no AC asks for it.\n  - The admin header brand changes to \"Admin console\" (new brand block). No AC covers this.\n  - settings._project_path makes a relative CMS_DATABASE resolve against the repo root. It helps the walkthrough, but no AC asks for it.\n  - app/main.py docstring rewrite and the publish.py refactor (home_html/post_html/page_html). These support AC7 and are fine.\n  \n  (c) Looks implemented but is wrong or risky\n  - .env now leaks into the test suite. settings loads .env when it is imported, and conftest only isolates DATABASE_PATH. In a temp copy, CMS_SITE_TITLE=Rajan's CMS (or any title with ' & or <) made test_export.py::test_post_and_page_header_shows_site_title_not_the_items_own_title fail. The template escapes the title, but the test checks for the raw string. The judge copies .env.example, whose title is \"My CMS\", so their run is safe. A student who sets a real title with an apostrophe gets a red suite. Fix it by escaping in the test, or by not loading .env under pytest.\n  - .claude/settings.json changes python3 to python in every hook. That fixes Windows but breaks the hooks on stock macOS and on Ubuntu/Debian, where `python` doesn't exist unless python-is-python3 is installed. The hooks are not in the judge's walkthrough. Still, the ticket asks to fix Windows, not to trade one platform for another.\n  - The hooks bullet in \"What to build\" (CMS_STUDENT documented in .env.example) is done. save_transcript.py already reads .env directly.\n</agent-message>"}

{"parentUuid":"031743c4-7a20-4257-9822-5e7d4d7475db","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfmCLhtEcsA3TPjJUfrTT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JSSWxifcUyFnW3toNgS7iX","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\claude\\C--Rajan-E-disk-My-work-IPHS400-code-mp2-cms\\77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e\\scratchpad\\T10-review-comment.md","content":"`/code-review` findings and resolutions, posted before closing this ticket. Two-axis review (Standards, Spec) run as parallel sub-agents against the working-tree diff (README.md excluded: the student's own AI Use Statement, out of scope).\n\nThe Spec reviewer independently replayed the judge's walkthrough on a temp copy of the tracked files (`cp .env.example .env` → `seed_demo.py` → app → `render_site`): seeding from `.env` alone works, `/` lists the published post and omits the draft, `/posts/welcome.html` and `/about.html` return 200, the draft URL is a 404, login works with the `.env.example` password, every admin page links `/style.css`, and the export has no root-absolute links. No public route can serve a draft (`get_published_by_slug` filters on status).\n\n## Fixed\n\n1. **`.env` with a UTF-8 BOM silently dropped its first variable** (Standards, demonstrated). PowerShell's `Out-File` writes a BOM, which glued onto the first key, so `CMS_SECRET_KEY` would vanish and the app would fall back to the dev key with no warning. Now read as `utf-8-sig`, with a test.\n2. **A developer's real `.env` leaked into the test suite** (Spec, demonstrated). A site title like `Jo's CMS` made an export test fail (it compared the raw title against escaped HTML). `conftest.py` now pins `settings.SITE_TITLE` per test, verified by rerunning the export tests with a hostile `CMS_SITE_TITLE`.\n3. **Reserved slug: edit path untested, export unguarded** (Spec). The check lives in the shared `_save`, so it already covered edit; added a test proving it. A Page saved with slug `index` before this check existed could still overwrite `site/index.html`, so `render_site()` and the nav now skip reserved slugs too, with a test.\n4. **Email normalization duplicated** (Standards). Login lowercased inline while `users.validate_email` did the same; added `users.normalize_email()`, used by both.\n5. **Reserved-slug error text was hard-wired to \"the home page\"** (Standards). The reason now lives next to each slug in `RESERVED_SLUGS`, so a second entry can't produce a wrong message.\n\n## Considered, not changed\n\n- **`python3` → `python` in `.claude/settings.json`** (Spec): correct for this Windows machine, where `python3` doesn't exist, but it would break the hooks on stock macOS/Debian. The hooks only run on the developer's machine and aren't part of the judge's walkthrough; this was the student's own edit, so I've flagged the trade-off to them rather than changing their config.\n- **Scope beyond the ACs** (Spec): seeding a published post plus a draft (needed so the deployed home page has a feed and visibly omits a draft), the admin header brand becoming \"Admin console\" (it previously showed each page's own title, noted on T07), and resolving a relative `CMS_DATABASE` against the project root (so `cms serve` and `seed_demo.py` share one file regardless of working directory). All small and in service of the walkthrough.\n- **Smells left as-is** (Standards): a third copy of a small `_seed` test helper; `home_html()` and `render_site()` each query published posts, and a Jinja `Environment` is built per rendered page — the renderers are deliberately standalone so the live public routes can call them one at a time; the cost is negligible at this size. The `.env` reader also doesn't support inline `# comments` or `export KEY=`; `.env.example` uses neither.\n- **Live preview message** says \"your session may have expired\" and also shows on a plain network error — acceptable; it's browser JS with no unit test.\n\nAlso done under this ticket: the gh-pages branch was rebuilt as a single fresh root commit (the old commit held a cp1252-encoded `style.css` that crashed `git log --all -p` decoding), and the live site now serves real published content at https://rajan-thakur.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/.\n\nFull suite: **166 passed, 0 failed** (includes Exercise B's `spend()`, committed separately).\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1490,"cache_read_input_tokens":588443,"output_tokens":1733,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":140},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1490,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1733,"cache_read_input_tokens":588443,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1490,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1490},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01JSSWxifcUyFnW3toNgS7iX":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\claude\\C--Rajan-E-disk-My-work-IPHS400-code-mp2-cms\\77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e\\scratchpad\\T10-review-comment.md","content":"`/code-review` findings and resolutions, posted before closing this ticket. No public route can serve a draft (`get_published_by_slug` filters on status).\n\n## Fixed\n\n1. **`.env` with a UTF-8 BOM silently dropped its first variable** (Standards, demonstrated). PowerShell's `Out-File` writes a BOM, which glued onto the first key, so `CMS_SECRET_KEY` would vanish and the app would fall back to the dev key with no warning. Now read as `utf-8-sig`, with a test.\n2. **A developer's real `.env` leaked into the test suite** (Spec, demonstrated). A site title like `Jo's CMS` made an export test fail (it compared the raw title against escaped HTML). `conftest.py` now pins `settings.SITE_TITLE` per test, verified by rerunning the export tests with a hostile `CMS_SITE_TITLE`.\n3. **Reserved slug: edit path untested, export unguarded** (Spec). The check lives in the shared `_save`, so it already covered edit; added a test proving it. A Page saved with slug `index` before this check existed could still overwrite `site/index.html`, so `render_site()` and the nav now skip reserved slugs too, with a test.\n4. **Email normalization duplicated** (Standards). Login lowercased inline while `users.validate_email` did the same; added `users.normalize_email()`, used by both.\n5. **Reserved-slug error text was hard-wired to \"the home page\"** (Standards). The reason now lives next to each slug in `RESERVED_SLUGS`, so a second entry can't produce a wrong message.\n\n## Considered, not changed\n\n- **`python3` → `python` in `.claude/settings.json`** (Spec): correct for this Windows machine, where `python3` doesn't exist, but it would break the hooks on stock macOS/Debian. users_module\nfrom app.templating import templates","originalFile":"\"\"\"Login, logout, and the current-user lookup every protected route reuses.\n\nThe login form carries a CSRF token like every other state-changing form —\n`security.read_or_mint_csrf` works for anonymous requests too, keyed only on\nthe request's cookies, not on who's logged in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app import users as users_module\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef _render_login(request: Request, error: str | None, status_code: int = 200):\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"error\": error, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The logged-in user's row, or None. Reusable as a FastAPI dependency.\"\"\"\n    uid = security.read_session(request.cookies.get(security.SESSION_COOKIE))\n    if uid is None:\n        return None\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND active = 1\", (uid,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _user_by_email(email: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    if current_user(request) is not None:\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    return _render_login(request, error=None)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403)\n\n    row = _user_by_email(users_module.normalize_email(email))\n    if row is None or not security.verify_password(password, row[\"password_hash\"]):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Incorrect email or password.\", status_code=401)\n    if not row[\"active\"]:\n        return _render_login(\n            request,\n            error=\"This account has been deactivated. Contact an Admin if you need access restored.\",\n            status_code=403,\n        )\n\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    response.set_cookie(\n        security.SESSION_COOKIE, security.sign_session(row[\"id\"]),\n        httponly=True, samesite=\"lax\", max_age=security.SESSION_MAX_AGE,\n    )\n    return response\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(...)):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please log in again.\", status_code=403)\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    response.delete_cookie(security.SESSION_COOKIE)\n    return response\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":10,"oldLines":13,"newStart":10,"newLines":10,"lines":[" "," from fastapi import APIRouter, Form, Request"," from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse","-from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates","-"," from app import db as db_module","-from app import security, settings","+from app import security"," from app import users as users_module","-","-templates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))","+from app.templating import templates"," router = APIRouter()"," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2a281220-7163-4ddd-9610-9aa3f4955205","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

Posts and Pages share the same table and almost all of this logic\n(see CONTEXT.md) — only the kind, URL prefix, and display label differ, so\n`posts.py` and `pages.py` are each a few lines that call `build_content_router`.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import security, settings\nfrom app.guards import require_admin, require_editor_or_admin\nfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nLIST_TEMPLATE = \"admin/content_list.html\"\nFORM_TEMPLATE = \"admin/content_form.html\"\n\n\ndef build_content_router(*, kind: str, url_prefix: str, label: str, label_plural: str) -> APIRouter:\n    router = APIRouter(prefix=url_prefix)\n    publish_detail = (\n        f\"Only an Admin can publish or unpublish a {label} — ask an Admin to do this for you.\"\n    )\n\n    def _require_admin_to_publish(request: Request):\n        return require_admin(request, detail=publish_detail)\n\n    def _render_form(request, user, *, item, title, slug, body_md, error, status_code=200):\n        csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n        response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, FORM_TEMPLATE,\n            {\n                \"title\": f\"Edit {label}\" if item else f\"New {label}\",\n                \"current_user\": user,\n                \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n                \"item\": item,\n                \"url_prefix\": url_prefix,\n                \"form_title\": title,\n                \"form_slug\": slug,\n                \"form_body_md\": body_md,\n                \"preview_html\": render_markdown(body_md),\n                \"error\": error,\n            },\n            status_code=status_code,\n        )\n        return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n    def _csrf_error(request, user, *, item, title, slug, body_md):\n        return _render_form(\n            request, user, item=item, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md,\n            error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", Posts and Pages share the same table and almost all of this logic\n(see CONTEXT.md) — only the kind, URL prefix, and display label differ, so\n`posts.py` and `pages.py` are each a few lines that call `build_content_router`.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, str) -> APIRouter:\n    router = APIRouter(prefix=url_prefix)\n    publish_detail = (\n        f\"Only an Admin can publish or unpublish a {label} — ask an Admin to do this for you.\"\n    )\n\n    def _require_admin_to_publish(request: Request):\n        return require_admin(request, detail=publish_detail)\n\n    def _render_form(request, user, *, item, title, slug, body_md, error, status_code=200):\n        csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n        response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, FORM_TEMPLATE,\n            {\n                \"title\": f\"Edit {label}\" if item else f\"New {label}\",\n                \"current_user\": user,\n                \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n                \"item\": item,\n                \"url_prefix\": url_prefix,\n                \"form_title\": title,\n                \"form_slug\": slug,\n                \"form_body_md\": body_md,\n                \"preview_html\": render_markdown(body_md),\n                \"error\": error,\n            },\n            status_code=status_code,\n        )\n        return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n    def _csrf_error(request, user, *, item, title, slug, body_md):\n        return _render_form(\n            request, user, item=item, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md,\n            error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403,\n        )\n\n    def _render_list(request, user, *, saved=None, error=None, status_code=200):\n        items = content_module.list_content(kind)\n        csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n        response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, LIST_TEMPLATE,\n            {\"title\": label_plural, \"label\": label, \"label_plural\": label_plural,\n             \"url_prefix\": url_prefix, \"current_user\": user, \"items\": items,\n             \"csrf_token\": csrf_token, \"saved\": saved, \"error\": error,\n             \"is_admin\": user[\"role\"] == \"admin\"},\n            status_code=status_code,\n        )\n        return the row,\n        and turn an IntegrityError (duplicate slug) into a form error\n        instead of a 500. `item` is None for create, the existing row for\n        update.\"\"\"\n        normalized_slug = content_module.validate_slug(slug)\n        if normalized_slug is None:\n            return _render_form(\n                request, user, item=item, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md,\n                error=\"Slug must be lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.\",\n            )\n        reserved_for = content_module.reserved_slug_reason(kind, normalized_slug)\n        if reserved_for:\n            return _render_form(\n                request, user, item=item, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md,\n                error=f'\"{normalized_slug}\" is reserved for {reserved_for} — choose another slug.',\n            )\n        try:\n            if item is None:\n                content_module.create_content(kind, title, normalized_slug, body_md, user[\"id\"])\n            else:\n                content_module.update_content(item[\"id\"], kind, title, normalized_slug, body_md)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n            return _render_form(\n                request, user, item=item, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md,\n                error=f\"That slug is already used by another {label.lower()}.\",\n            )\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{url_prefix}?saved={redirect_saved_as}\", status_code=303)\n\n    def _apply_status_change(request, user, item_id, *, new_status, saved_as, csrf_token):\n        if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n            return _render_list(\n                request, user, error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403,\n            )\n        item = content_module.get_content(item_id, kind)\n        if item is None:\n            return RedirectResponse(url_prefix, status_code=303)\n        content_module.set_status(item_id, kind, new_status)\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{url_prefix}?saved={saved_as}\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.get(\"\")\n    def list_items(request: Request, user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin)):\n        return _render_list(request, user, saved=request.query_params.get(\"saved\"))\n\n    @router.get(\"/new\")\n    def new_item_form(request: Request, user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin)):\n        return _render_form(request, user, item=None, title=\"\", slug=\"\", body_md=\"\", error=None)\n\n    @router.post(\"/new\")\n    def create_item(\n        request: Request,\n        title: str = Form(...),\n        slug: str = Form(...),\n        body_md: str = Form(\"\"),\n        csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n        user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin),\n    ):\n        if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n            return _csrf_error(request, user, item=None, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md)\n        return _save(request, user, item=None, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md,\n                     redirect_saved_as=\"created\")\n\n    @router.get(\"/{item_id}/edit\")\n    def edit_item_form(request: Request, item_id: int, user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin)):\n        item = item=item, title=item[\"title\"], slug=item[\"slug\"],\n            body_md=item[\"body_md\"], error=None,\n        )\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/edit\")\n    def update_item(\n        request: Request,\n        item_id: int,\n        title: str = Form(...),\n        slug: str = Form(...),\n        body_md: str = Form(\"\"),\n        csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n        user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin),\n    ):\n        item = content_module.get_content(item_id, kind)\n        if item is None:\n            return RedirectResponse(url_prefix, status_code=303)\n        if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n            return _csrf_error(request, user, item=item, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md)\n        return _save(request, user, item=item, title=title, slug=slug, body_md=body_md,\n                     redirect_saved_as=\"updated\")\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/delete\")\n    def delete_item(\n        request: Request,\n        item_id: int,\n        csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n        user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin),\n    ):\n        if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n            return _render_list(\n                request, user, error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403,\n            )\n        content_module.delete_content(item_id, kind)\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{url_prefix}?saved=deleted\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/publish\")\n    def publish_item(\n        request: Request, item_id: int, csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n        user=Depends(_require_admin_to_publish),\n    ):\n        return _apply_status_change(\n            request, user, item_id, new_status=content_module.STATUS_PUBLISHED,\n            saved_as=\"published\", csrf_token=csrf_token,\n        )\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/unpublish\")\n    def unpublish_item(\n        request: Request, item_id: int, csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n        user=Depends(_require_admin_to_publish),\n    ):\n        return _apply_status_change(\n            request, user, item_id, new_status=content_module.STATUS_DRAFT,\n            saved_as=\"unpublished\", csrf_token=csrf_token,\n        )\n\n    @router.post(\"/preview\")\n    def preview_item(body_md: str = Form(\"\"), user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin)):\n        \"\"\"Render+sanitize arbitrary Markdown for the live preview pane. No\n        CSRF check: this has no side effect, it only echoes back sanitized HTML.\"\"\"\n        return HTMLResponse(render_markdown(body_md))\n\n    return router\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":9,"oldLines":12,"newStart":9,"newLines":13,"lines":[" "," from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request"," from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse","+"," from app import content as content_module"," from app import security"," from app.guards import require_admin, require_editor_or_admin"," from app.mdrender import render_markdown","+from app.templating import templates"," ","-"," LIST_TEMPLATE = \"admin/content_list.html\""," FORM_TEMPLATE = \"admin/content_form.html\""," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"21c5a5aa-c42e-4616-834d-9978de9448ab","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

Reusable as a FastAPI dependency.\"\"\"\n    uid = security.read_session(request.cookies.get(security.SESSION_COOKIE))\n    if uid is None:\n        return None\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ? AND active = 1\", (uid,)\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _user_by_email(email: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    if current_user(request) is not None:\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    return _render_login(request, error=None)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(...),\n):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please try again.\", status_code=403)\n\n    row = _user_by_email(users_module.normalize_email(email))\n    if row is None or not security.verify_password(password, row[\"password_hash\"]):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Incorrect email or password.\", status_code=401)\n    if not row[\"active\"]:\n        return _render_login(\n            request,\n            error=\"This account has been deactivated. Contact an Admin if you need access restored.\",\n            status_code=403,\n        )\n\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n    response.set_cookie(\n        security.SESSION_COOKIE, security.sign_session(row[\"id\"]),\n        httponly=True, samesite=\"lax\", max_age=security.SESSION_MAX_AGE,\n    )\n    return response\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(...)):\n    if not security.verify_csrf(csrf_token, request.cookies.get(security.CSRF_COOKIE)):\n        return _render_login(request, error=\"Your session expired — please log in again.\", status_code=403)\n    response = RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    response.delete_cookie(security.SESSION_COOKIE)\n    return response\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":10,"oldLines":6,"newStart":10,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," from fastapi import APIRouter, Form, Request"," from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse","+"," from app import db as db_module"," from app import security"," from app import users as users_module"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"79124c80-b9e3-4670-a10a-b3d83e105163","session_id":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"77346485-805e-46b5-86aa-e4a072c5d79e","version":"2.1.291","gitBranch":"main","slug":"proud-herding-wadler"}

{"parentUuid":"edff15ed-380a-4f23-b23b-a415b3e80cea","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfmCfow9yprUgtw7r2YVu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Xt382cmvu7aCoe9orzZtiy","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_admin_links.py","content":"\"\"\"T10: every admin link and form action is relative and resolves to a real\nroute from the page it appears on (ticket #11). check_submission.py rejects\nany `href=\"/` in a template, and a relative link is only right if it's\nright at that page's depth -- so resolve each one the way a browser would.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\nclass _Links(HTMLParser):\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.hrefs: list[str] = []\n        self.forms: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        attrs = dict(attrs)\n        if tag in (\"a\", \"link\") and attrs.get(\"href\"):\n            self.hrefs.append(attrs[\"href\"])\n        if tag == \"form\" and attrs.get(\"action\"):\n            self.forms.append((attrs.get(\"method\", \"get\").lower(), attrs[\"action\"]))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded_ids():\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        admin_id = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    return {\n        \"post_id\": content_module.create_content(\"post\", \"P\", \"p\", \"x\", admin_id),\n        \"page_id\": content_module.create_content(\"page\", \"Pg\", \"pg\", \"x\", admin_id),\n    }\n\n\nADMIN_PAGES = [\n    \"/admin\", \"/admin/content\",\n    \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/posts/new\", \"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\",\n    \"/admin/pages\", \"/admin/pages/new\", \"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\",\n    \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/users/new\",\n]\n\n\ndef _assert_links_resolve(client, page_path: str) -> None:\n    response = client.get(page_path)\n    assert response.status_code == 200, page_path\n    parser = _Links()\n    parser.feed(response.text)\n    assert parser.hrefs, f\"no links found on {page_path}\"\n\n    page_url = BASE + page_path\n    for href in parser.hrefs:\n        assert not href.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_path}: root-absolute \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"title\": \"My First Post\", \"slug\": \"my-first-post\", \"body_md\": \"Hello.\",\n              \"csrf_token\": csrf},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/posts?saved=created\"\n\n    posts = content_module.list_content(\"post\")\n    assert len(posts) == 1\n    assert posts[0][\"title\"] == \"My First Post\"\n    assert posts[0][\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef test_editor_can_edit_a_post_authored_by_another_editor(client_as):\n    # Seed a second editor account directly (the client_as fixture only knows\n    # about the one demo editor), so this genuinely exercises cross-author edit.\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, active) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor', 1)\",\n            (\"other-editor@example.test\", hash_password(\"whatever-pw\")),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        other_id = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (\"other-editor@example.test\",)\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n    post_id = content_module.create_content(\"post\", \"Original\", \"original\", \"v1\", other_id)\n\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    edit_page = editor.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\")\n    assert edit_page.status_code == 200\n    csrf = extract_csrf(edit_page.text)\n    response = editor.post(\n        f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\",\n        data={\"title\": \"Edited\", \"slug\": \"original\", \"body_md\": \"v2\", \"csrf_token\": csrf},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    updated = content_module.get_content(post_id, \"post\")\n    assert updated[\"title\"] == \"Edited\"\n    assert updated[\"body_md\"] == \"v2\"\n\n\ndef test_editor_can_delete_a_post(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    csrf = _csrf_from(editor)\n    editor.post(\"/admin/posts/new\",\n                data={\"title\": \"Temp\", \"slug\": \"temp\", \"body_md\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": csrf})\n    post_id = content_module.list_content(\"post\")[0][\"id\"]\n\n    list_page = editor.get(\"/admin/posts\")\n    csrf2 = extract_csrf(list_page.text)\n    response = editor.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\",\n                            data={\"csrf_token\": csrf2}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/posts?saved=deleted\"\n    assert content_module.get_content(post_id, \"post\") is None\n\n\ndef test_create_post_rejects_missing_csrf(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\"/admin/posts/new\",\n                            data={\"title\": \"x\", \"slug\": \"x\", \"body_md\": \"x\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 422\n\n\ndef test_create_post_rejects_wrong_csrf(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = editor.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"title\": \"x\", \"slug\": \"x\", \"body_md\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": \"wrong\"},\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_edit_post_rejects_wrong_csrf(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    csrf = _csrf_from(editor)\n    editor.post(\"/admin/posts/new\",\n                data={\"title\": \"x\", \"slug\": \"x\", \"body_md\": \"x\", \"csrf_token\": it's\nright at that page's depth -- so resolve each one the way a browser would.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\nclass _Links(HTMLParser):\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.hrefs: list[str] = []\n        self.forms: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        attrs = dict(attrs)\n        if tag in (\"a\", \"link\") and attrs.get(\"href\"):\n            self.hrefs.append(attrs[\"href\"])\n        if tag == \"form\" and attrs.get(\"action\"):\n            self.forms.append((attrs.get(\"method\", \"get\").lower(), attrs[\"action\"]))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded_ids():\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        admin_id = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    return {\n        \"post_id\": content_module.create_content(\"post\", \"P\", \"p\", \"x\", admin_id),\n        \"page_id\": content_module.create_content(\"page\", \"Pg\", \"pg\", \"x\", admin_id),\n    }\n\n\nADMIN_PAGES = [\n    \"/admin\", \"/admin/content\",\n    \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/posts/new\", \"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\",\n    \"/admin/pages\", \"/admin/pages/new\", \"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\",\n    \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/users/new\",\n]\n\n\ndef _assert_links_resolve(client, page_path: str) -> None:\n    response = client.get(page_path)\n    assert response.status_code == 200, page_path\n    parser = _Links()\n    parser.feed(response.text)\n    assert parser.hrefs, f\"no links found on {page_path}\"\n\n    page_url = BASE + page_path\n    for href in parser.hrefs:\n        assert not href.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_path}: root-absolute href {href!r}\"\n        target = urlsplit(urljoin(page_url, href))\n        status = client.get(target.path, params=target.query or None).status_code\n        assert status != 404, f\"{page_path}: href {href!r} -> {target.path} is a 404\"\n\n    for method, action in parser.forms:\n        assert not action.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_path}: root-absolute action {action!r}\"\n        target = urlsplit(urljoin(page_url, action)).path\n        # An empty submission is rejected (422/403) but must reach a real route.\n        status = client.request(method.upper(), target).status_code\n        assert status not in (404, 405), f\"{page_path}: form {action!r} -> {target} is {status}\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path_template\", ADMIN_PAGES)\ndef test_every_admin_link_is_relative_and_resolves(client_as, seeded_ids, path_template):\n    _assert_links_resolve(client_as(\"admin\"), path_template.format(**seeded_ids))\n\n\ndef test_login_page_links_are_relative_and_resolve(client):\n    _assert_links_resolve(client, The rule \"templates want the prefix without its leading slash\" is applied separately in two files to the same constants:\n    `link_prefix = url_prefix.lstrip(\"/\")` (content_crud.py)\n    `EDIT_URL_PREFIX = {posts_module.KIND: posts_module.URL_PREFIX.lstrip(\"/\"), ...}` (dashboard.py)\n    A slash-less LINK_PREFIX constant in posts.py/pages.py would keep it in one place.\n  - Data Clump. `{{ root }}{{ link_prefix }}` appears 7 times across content_list and content_form. Optional fix: a small `rel('admin/posts')` global. Not required.\n  - Mysterious Name (mild). `root` reads like \"/\", but it holds \"../../\". The base.html comment explains it; a name like `to_root` would read better.\n  \n  (c) Correctness\n  - Depth formula `max(path.count(\"/\") - 1, 0)` is correct. It counts the directory segments of the request URL, so it doesn't matter which template renders.\n    - I POSTed bad CSRF to /admin/posts/1/{delete,publish,edit}, /admin/posts/new, /admin/users/new, /admin/users/1/role and /login (scratch test, repo untouched). Each 403 page emitted the right \"../\" count and every link and action resolved: no 404 or 405.\n    - Trailing-slash URLs (/admin/, /admin/posts/) 307-redirect before rendering. The formula would be right for them anyway.\n    - The preview fetch() URL is also right at both depths.\n  - Can the test catch a wrong depth? I swapped the context processor for count-2 (one level too shallow): 9 of 11 tests fail. Only /admin and /login pass, because both have depth 0 and can't be checked anyway. So it is not vacuous for too-shallow roots.\n  - Gaps (no bug, but worth a comment):\n    1. Too many \"../\" is never caught: count+0 extra levels still gives 11/11 pass. That's harmless, because browsers and urljoin both stop at the server root.\n    2. Hrefs only reject 404, so a 500 or 422 target passes. Forms also accept 422, which a wrong route whose path parameter fails to parse could return. The current route table has no such collision.\n    3. The test proves a route exists, not that it's the right one. A delete form pointing at /publish would pass.\n    4. Error pages from POSTs aren't covered. They are correct today, but one parametrized CSRF-failure case would lock that in.\n  \n  No demonstrated bugs.\n</agent-message>"}

  self.hrefs: list[str] = []\n        self.forms: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        attrs = dict(attrs)\n        if tag in (\"a\", \"link\") and work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_admin_links.py","content":"\"\"\"T11: every admin link and form action is relative and resolves to a real\nroute from the page it appears on (ticket #12). check_submission.py rejects\nany `href=\"/` in a template, and a relative link is only right if it's\nright at that page's depth -- so resolve each one the way a browser would.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import content as content_module\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\nclass _Links(HTMLParser):\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.hrefs: list[str] = []\n        self.forms: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        attrs = dict(attrs)\n        if tag in (\"a\", \"link\") and attrs.get(\"href\"):\n            self.hrefs.append(attrs[\"href\"])\n        if tag == \"form\" and attrs.get(\"action\"):\n            self.forms.append((attrs.get(\"method\", \"get\").lower(), attrs[\"action\"]))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded_ids():\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        admin_id = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'admin@example.test'\"\n        ).fetchone()[\"id\"]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    return {\n        \"post_id\": content_module.create_content(\"post\", \"P\", \"p\", \"x\", admin_id),\n        \"page_id\": content_module.create_content(\"page\", \"Pg\", \"pg\", \"x\", admin_id),\n    }\n\n\nADMIN_PAGES = [\n    \"/admin\", \"/admin/content\",\n    \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/posts/new\", \"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\",\n    \"/admin/pages\", \"/admin/pages/new\", \"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\",\n    \"/admin/users\", \"/admin/users/new\",\n]\n\n\ndef _assert_links_resolve(client, page_path: str, html: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Every href/action in `html`, as served at `page_path`, is relative and\n    resolves to a real route from there.\"\"\"\n    parser = _Links()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    assert parser.hrefs, f\"no links found on {page_path}\"\n\n    page_url = BASE + page_path\n    for href in parser.hrefs:\n        assert not href.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_path}: root-absolute href {href!r}\"\n        target = urlsplit(urljoin(page_url, href))\n        status = client.get(target.path, params=target.query or None).status_code\n        assert status != 404 and status < 500, f\"{page_path}: href {href!r} -> {target.path} is {status}\"\n\n    for method, action in parser.forms:\n        assert not action.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_path}: root-absolute action {action!r}\"\n        target = urlsplit(urljoin(page_url, action)).path\n        # An empty submission is rejected (422/403) but must reach a real route.\n        status = client.request(method.upper(), target).status_code\n        assert status not in (404, 405) and status < 500, f\"{page_path}: form {action!r} -> {target} is {status}\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path_template\", ADMIN_PAGES)\ndef test_every_admin_link_is_relative_and_resolves(client_as, seeded_ids, path_template):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    path = path_template.format(**seeded_ids)\n    response = admin.get(path)\n    assert response.status_code == 200, path\n    _assert_links_resolve(admin, path, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_login_page_links_are_relative_and_resolve(client):\n    _assert_links_resolve(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n\n# A failed POST re-renders a page at the deeper POST URL (e.g. a list page at\n# /admin/posts/3/delete), so its links need more \"../\" than the GET page did.\nFAILED_POST_PAGES = [\n    \"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\", \"/admin/pages/{page_id}/publish\",\n    \"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\", \"/admin/users/{post_id}/role\",\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path_template\", FAILED_POST_PAGES)\ndef test_links_on_a_page_rendered_by_a_failed_post_still_resolve(\n    client_as, seeded_ids, path_template,\n):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    path = path_template.format(**seeded_ids)\n    response = admin.post(path, data={\"title\": \"x\", \"slug\": \"x\", \"body_md\": \"x\",\n                                      \"role\": \"editor\", \"csrf_token\": \"forged\"})\n    assert response.status_code == 403, path  # rejected, rendered as an error page\n    _assert_links_resolve(admin, path, response.text)\n","numLines":109,"startLine":1,"totalLines":109}},"displayPath":"tests\\test_admin_links.py"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"9f10278c-f35f-4fa1-83f1-1b5bfb9a698a","timestamp":"2026-10-06T15:35:01.319Z","rendered":[{"content":"<system-reminder>\nCalled import require_editor_or_admin\nfrom app.routes import pages as pages_module\nfrom app.routes import posts as posts_module\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nVALID_STATUSES = {content_module.STATUS_DRAFT, content_module.STATUS_PUBLISHED}\n# Relative to the server root; templates prepend `to_root` (see app/templating.py).\nEDIT_URL_PREFIX = {posts_module.KIND: posts_module.URL_PREFIX.lstrip(\"/\"),\n                   pages_module.KIND: pages_module.URL_PREFIX.lstrip(\"/\")}\nVALID_KINDS = set(EDIT_URL_PREFIX)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin)):\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/dashboard.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"current_user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n         \"counts\": content_module.count_by_status()},\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/content\")\ndef content_overview(\n    request: Request,\n    status: str | None = Query(None),\n    content_type: str | None = Query(None, alias=\"type\"),\n    user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin),\n):\n    status_filter = status if status in VALID_STATUSES else None\n    kind_filter = content_type if content_type in VALID_KINDS else None\n    items = content_module.list_filtered(status=status_filter, kind=kind_filter)\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/content_overview.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"All content\", \"current_user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n         \"items\": items, \"status_filter\": status_filter or \"all\",\n         \"type_filter\": kind_filter or \"all\", \"edit_url_prefix\": EDIT_URL_PREFIX},\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response,
